Akshaya Vajpeyarr

AI Engineer · Generative AI & RAG Systems · Software Development Engineer

I'm an AI Engineer specializing in Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and enterprise AI deployment, currently completing a Master of Computing (AI Specialization) at the National University of Singapore. Over the past few years I've built multi-agent tutoring systems, production RAG pipelines with FAISS and ChromaDB, and computer-vision models achieving up to 97% classification accuracy — spanning internships at The Software Practice and Capgemini's Applied Innovation Exchange. I care about turning research-grade AI techniques into systems that are fast, cost-efficient, and reliable in production, from semantic search and LLM orchestration to inference optimization. My toolkit spans Python, C#/ASP.NET Core, LangGraph, PyTorch, and TensorFlow, backed by a published research paper on hybrid CNN-ViT architectures for medical imaging. Currently exploring agentic AI systems and scalable backend engineering — let's build something intelligent together.

About Me

Bridging ML Research with Production Software Engineering

NUS MComp AI '26
Quick Navigation:
Work Experience Education Projects Skills Certifications

I'm Akshaya Vajpeyarr, an AI Engineer currently pursuing a Master of Computing (Artificial Intelligence Specialization) at the National University of Singapore, following a Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering (AI & ML) from Sri Ramachandra Faculty of Engineering and Technology, where I graduated with a 9.3/10 GPA.

My expertise centers on Generative AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation — I've designed embedding pipelines, semantic search systems, and multi-agent architectures using LangGraph, LangChain, FAISS, Pinecone, and ChromaDB. On the engineering side, I've built and shipped production backend features in C# and ASP.NET Core at The Software Practice, and deployed RAG pipelines for enterprise search at Capgemini's Applied Innovation Exchange.

My work spans the full AI stack: from PyTorch and TensorFlow model training (including a published hybrid CNN-ViT architecture achieving ~97% accuracy on brain tumor classification) to FastAPI/JWT-authenticated backends and React frontends. What sets me apart is combining rigorous ML experimentation with a strong product and deployment mindset — I don't just train models, I ship them.

🎯

My Mission

To build AI systems that are not just technically impressive but genuinely reliable, cost-efficient, and usable in production — bridging the gap between research-grade techniques and real-world deployment.

🚀

My Vision

To grow into an AI engineer who can architect end-to-end intelligent systems — from retrieval and orchestration to inference optimization — that make complex AI capabilities accessible and dependable at scale.

Featured Projects & Publications

Multi-Agent Systems, RAG Pipelines, Computer Vision, & Published Research

Multi-Agent AI / Product 01

StudyAI — Agentic Personalized Learning System

2025

A multi-agent tutoring system built with LangGraph, featuring a router and specialist nodes for teaching, quiz generation, and evaluation, plus a profiler node that adapts to the learner's history. Backed by a session- and user-scoped RAG pipeline supporting 7 file formats with isolated retrieval per user/session.

1 Improved response accuracy by 30% over a single-agent baseline
2 RAG pipeline supporting PDF, DOCX, PPTX, CSV, XLSX, JSON, & TXT with Camelot table extraction
3 Dual vector-store architecture (ChromaDB / Pinecone) with strict user/session isolation
4 Full-stack with FastAPI, JWT auth, streaming chat & React/Vite on Groq Llama 3.3
LangGraph FastAPI React Vite ChromaDB Pinecone FastEmbed JWT Groq / Llama 3.3
RAG Application 02

AI Interview Coach

2025

A role-specific AI interview practice tool that generates tailored questions from a job description, evaluates responses with structured feedback, adjusts difficulty based on performance, and produces a personalized improvement report.

1 Built RAG question generator using Chroma retrieval over a job-description corpus
2 Structured Pydantic outputs ensuring reliable, validated answer evaluations
3 Deterministic interview orchestration in Python with conversational LLM flexibility
4 Complete workflow: Role selection → Question generation → Evaluation → Detailed report

Machine Learning 03

Singapore Housing Market — Predicting HDB Resale Prices

2025

A gradient-boosted ML framework enriched with geospatial and economic data to predict HDB resale prices in Singapore, with a strong focus on explainability (SHAP) and transparent, iterative experimentation.

1 Reduced RMSE from linear/MLP baseline down to ~31,200 via Gradient Boosting
2 Selected cross-validated HistGradientBoosting final model with custom reweighted RMSE loss
3 Engineered cyclical time features, target encoding & rental/RPI economic indicators
4 SHAP analysis confirming flat size, remaining lease & regional indicators as main drivers
Python Scikit-Learn GeoPandas SHAP Jupyter Conda

Published Research 06
📄 Published by IGI Global (2025)

Attention-Driven CNN–ViT Feature Fusion for Brain Tumor Classification

2025

A hybrid deep-learning architecture combining DenseNet-201, Vision Transformers, and cross-attention fusion for multi-scale brain tumor classification from multimodal MRI scans, published by IGI Global (2025).

1 Extracted fine, medium & coarse-grained MRI features using DenseNet-201
2 Designed cross-attention fusion mechanism combining multi-scale representations
3 Evaluated on BraTS 2015 dataset across T1, T1ce, T2, and FLAIR modalities
4 Achieved ~97% classification accuracy, outperforming standalone DenseNet-201 (~86%) & ViT (~93%)
TensorFlow / Keras DenseNet-201 Vision Transformers Self-Attention Cross-Attention
